text: Hermes agentning skill hub qī mavjūt balib u tayyār skillerkt panasi khasablanad.
Unde yuz lab turlī skiller mavjūt, vazilār hermes tamandan yaratilgan, vazilār hamjamiya tamandan bolshurgan.
Siz azingiz uçun kerekri skill neşu hubdán topub, hermes ke arnaçni būršingiz mūnkün.
Amma bekzad, estetutin, sizning hermes lakalsiz, internetke bewaste boglakh emasiz.
